dialogues.speaker: Hoa
dialogues.text: Greetings there, my friend. Do you need a letter mailed by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You work for the postal service?

dialogues.speaker: Hoa
dialogues.text: More or less. Us Scions of the Canopy are quite adept at traveling through the woods at high speed, so we took on most of the messenger work.

dialogues.speaker: Hoa
dialogues.text: We'd establish Courier Longhouses all over Natlan, and help the tribes deliver letters and packages.

dialogues.speaker: Hoa
dialogues.text: Sometimes, we'd also help the tribes recruit people for events, or coordinate collaborations between different tribes.

dialogues.speaker: Hoa
dialogues.text: I won't disturb you any longer, then.

dialogues.speaker: Hoa
dialogues.text: They actually come up quite a lot. Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Hoa
dialogues.text: Sometimes, adventurers would want to hire a guide from the People of the Springs, or request a doctor from the Masters of the Night-Wind. If they don't know how to find such individuals themselves, they'll often ask me to pass on the word.

dialogues.speaker: Hoa
dialogues.text: Everyone has strengths and weaknesses. It's only right to help each other out.

dialogues.speaker: Hoa
dialogues.text: Everyone has strengths and weaknesses. It's only right that we help each other out.

dialogues.speaker: Hoa
dialogues.text: Y'know, like when we were struggling with the Abyss. I was running here and there delivering an endless torrent of messages and letters, and after it was all over, I had to take a much-needed rest.

dialogues.speaker: Hoa
dialogues.text: But thanks to our brave heroes, I guess we won't ever have to face another war like that.
